item.title: Rang De Basanti turns 20: Special screening planned in Mumbai for cast and crew
item.description: Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra’s Rang De Basanti, widely regarded as one of the defining films of the 2000s, has completed 20 years since its theatrical release.
